reviews.title: Keyboard review
reviews.comment: I’ve been testing out the EPOMAKER X Aula F75 MAX, and I’m honestly blown away. It "works amazing" right out of the box and feels like a premium piece of tech that should cost way more than it does. The Highlights: Premium Feel & "Clicky" Satisfaction: The build quality is top-tier. It feels incredibly solid, and the typing experience is a dream. I absolutely love how clicky and responsive it is—it makes everything from gaming to late-night typing sessions feel so much more satisfying. Insane Value for Money: Here’s the kicker—this keyboard is only around 70 bucks. Most other "big name" brands charge well over $100 for these same features. You're getting pro-level performance without the "brand tax." It’s easily the best mechanical keyboard you can get on a budget. Cool & Simple Customization: The LED lighting is gorgeous, and more importantly, changing the settings is really simple. You don't need a PhD in software to make it look cool; it’s intuitive and looks stunning on any desk. Final Verdict, If you want a keyboard that feels amazing, sounds great, and keeps your wallet happy, this is it. It punches way above its weight class and holds its own against keyboards twice the price. 10/10 would recommend!
reviews.author: Patrick

reviews.title: Great Keyboard for the Price
reviews.comment: This keyboard feels great right out of the box. It has lubed switches that are nice and smooth as soon as you get it out. The RGB lighting effects are really nice and you can use the knob and screen to change them without having to get into any software. It has solid weight to it that makes it feel premium. Very easy to get it connected just plug it in for wired mode or use the dongle for wifi connection or pair it for bluetooth so it will work on many different devices. The screen is a nice touch to upload gifs and have some style on your keyboard. This sound of the keyboard is very satisfying and the switches are very smooth.
reviews.author: Charles E.

reviews.title: Great keyboard with many options
reviews.comment: Outstanding keyboard with multiple connection options.  The keys have a nice feel to them, providing good feedback with a nice sound which will not bother anyone in the area. The keyboard has a nice weight to it keeping it in place on a sliding keyboard drawer.  The lighting options and key programmability are nice pluses, along with the wheel and small screen, but what makes this keyboard great is the solid functionality. I did find the lack of a dedicated 'Home' key surprising, and using the wheel to control speaker volume requires pressing on it first, but these are very minor compared to the solid performance. The keyboard also looks good and seems very sturdy and dependable. Recommended and a good value, I like this more than the options from well-known premium brands.
reviews.author: Matt L

reviews.title: Creamy, nice, and cheap.
reviews.comment: Very very creamy, the weight is good, it's not to heavy and actually kind of light. the quality is insane! the response is good and the connectivity is also good! most keyboards like this cost hundreds of dollars so this type of keyboard for a very cheap price is insane! the battery life is long and good, overall it's a super good keyboard!
reviews.author: alex thurman

reviews.title: Great Keyboard, Bad Software
reviews.comment: I really love this keyboard. it's a very solid keyboard, with a decent price, that has a nice thocky and milky sound that is so pleasant to listen to while typing. It made me fall in love with the LEOBOG Switches that it comes with. However, I have one BIG GLARING issue with this keyboard, which makes me not want to buy another AULA keyboard again, and that is the software. EVERY VERSION that i've downloaded and tried, it won't sync to the keyboard or detect it at all. This is including when I have it plugged it with the wire.
